name: reference
title: Reference
description: A reference to external resources and information related to the class.
comments: In Latimer Core, this class can be used to store references to publications, policies, datasets and other online resources such as websites, related to classes within the standard.
rdfs:comment: A reference to external resources and information related to the class.

fields.name: reference_pk
fields.title: Reference (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for an ltc:Reference.
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.
fields.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for an ltc:Reference.

fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key). Optional: a row belongs to exactly one parent, so populate exactly one of this table's parent foreign keys.

fields.name: referenceDetails
fields.title: Reference Details
fields.description: Detailed information about the resource being referenced.
fields.examples: `This dataset includes a Darwin Core Archive of the ~8000 specimens digitised to date, of which ~80% also have an associated label image.`, `de Mestier A, Mulcahy D, Harris DJ, et al. (2023) Policies Handbook on Using Molecular Collections. Research Ideas and Outcomes 9: e102908. https://doi.org/10.3897/rio.9.e102908`, `Suggested citation: USDA-ARS US National Fungus Collection (2023). USDA United States National Fungus Collections. Occurrence dataset https://doi.org/10.15468/w78rwb accessed via GBIF.org on 2023-04-27.`
fields.rdfs:comment: Detailed information about the resource being referenced.

fields.name: referenceName
fields.title: Reference Name
fields.description: A name given to a reference.
fields.comments: If the reference is to a publication, this field should hold the publication title; otherwise any appropriate, short, text label relevant to the resource being referenced may be used.
fields.examples: `Digitised specimen records on the NHM Data Portal`, `Using a Collection Health Index to prioritise access and activities in the New Zealand Arthropod Collection`, `BGBM loans policy`, `Herbarium Wikipedia page`, `NMNH website`, `Related sequences in GenBank`
fields.rdfs:comment: A name given to a reference.

fields.name: referenceType
fields.title: Reference Type
fields.description: The type of resource being referenced.
fields.comments: This property is intended to be used for a high level categorisation of resource types.
fields.rdfs:comment: The type of resource being referenced.

fields.name: resourceIRI
fields.title: Resource IRI
fields.description: A preferably resolvable IRI providing access to the resource defined in the reference.
fields.rdfs:comment: A preferably resolvable IRI providing access to the resource defined in the reference.
